_comment: Living project tracker for LearnGuard & LearnShield. Updated as work happens. See CLAUDE.md for session rules.

completed.title: Bundle face-api.min.js locally for LearnGuard
completed.details: Copied _ls_work/learnshield/amd/build/face-api.min.js to _lg_work/learnguard/thirdpartylibs/face-api.min.js. view.php's existing file_exists() check now finds it first, so LearnGuard no longer depends on LearnShield being installed or falling back to cdn.jsdelivr.net. Both plugins now 100% local/embedded AI.

completed.title: Wizard parity + overview rewrite (v1.6.3 / v1.6.1)
completed.details: Ported LearnShield v1.5.9 wizard UX fixes to LearnGuard (scroll-to-top, closetabs scroll-lock, photo-ID loading/warning states). Added LearnShield Grades nav link (Option B). Rewrote both overview.php pages into full feature/link grids and made them the first admin page in each plugin.

completed.title: LearnGuard v1.6.2 - critical bugfixes
completed.details: Fixed invalid install.xml (missing space broke fresh installs) and results.php/export_scores.php querying non-existent a.score/a.maxscore columns.

completed.title: LearnGuard v1.6.1 - All Scores admin page
completed.details: scores.php: sortable/filterable per-attempt score list with CSV/Excel/PDF export.

completed.title: v1.6.0 - Per-learner scheduling, dual countdown, grader.php fix
completed.details: schedule.php in both plugins (learnguard_schedules table / native quiz_overrides). Dual open/close countdown on view + during attempt. Fixed LearnGuard grader.php to mirror gradeessays.php pattern.

planned.title: Clean up legacy siteadmin_ai.php (Ollama/Docker references)
planned.notes: _lg_work/learnguard/siteadmin_ai.php is leftover from the superseded learnguard-ai/ Docker+Ollama architecture. ai_ollama_* settings aren't read anywhere else in the codebase - page is dead but still linked from overview.php's 'AI Services' card and could mislead Michael into thinking Docker is required.
